title: Practice 5: Prepositional endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Том вырос в ___ (дружный) семье.
exercises.prompt: Tom grew up in a close-knit family.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «семье»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I live in a block of flats.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «доме»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Дипломаты находятся в ___ (шаткий) положении.
exercises.prompt: The diplomats are in a precarious position.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «положении»: prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Most funny stories are based on comic situations.

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «ситуациях»: prepositional plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
